title: test_fetch_session_rejects_non_http_other_urls: always tests uploadUrl, not downloadUrl/eventSourceUrl
description: The test mounts three mocks on the same path in a loop. wiremock uses insertion order when priority is equal (all default to 5), so the first-mounted mock (uploadUrl=ftp://) is always served. In iterations 2 and 3, the test still passes because the uploadUrl is still wrong in the body — but it is NOT testing downloadUrl or eventSourceUrl rejection. A bug in validate_session_urls that skipped downloadUrl or eventSourceUrl would go undetected by this test. The mock for iteration N should replace or supersede the iteration N-1 mock, e.g. by using mount_as_scoped() so each mock drops at the end of each loop iteration.
